description: Sample of active establishments registered with the Cámara de Comercio de Medellín para Antioquia, from the RUES open data. It says what each shop registered, not what it sells.

source.publisher: Confecámaras (Registro Único Empresarial y Social, RUES)

owners.dataset: Personas Naturales, Personas Jurídicas y Entidades Sin Animo de Lucro

sampling.method: Per main CIIU code, rows ordered by SHA-256 of registryKey, first N kept.

privacy: Owners that are natural persons keep no identifier, because their NIT is their cédula. Company NITs are kept. Legal representatives are not included.
notes: registryKey is the cámara code and the matrícula. It is a registry id, not a wallet address.
A CIIU code is registered activity, not proof of what a shop sells. 4773 also covers cosmetics and toiletries.
This file is evidence input. It does not bind any shop to an Open Payments wallet.
